detail.longDescription:
about 2 weeks since I setup Notesnook for a replacement for #google keep.  So far, it. just. works.  Its the seemless works when it needs to, out of you way when it doesnt notes app that I need it to be.  check-lists work as expected, notes sync quickly, i havent had a single instance where i put something in there, and didnt find it on another machine seconds later.  No funny gimmicky crap added in there, its just notes, and things that make sense alongside notes.  

Now, to figure out how to export my hundreds of little notes from Keep, and import them into Notesnook.  

#degoogle #notes #keep #googlekeep #selfhosted #digitalselfreliance
